Simon's advice for people who can't identify their purpose: start with service. Purpose isn't found by looking inward — it's found by showing up for someone else.

His illustration: a friend in a rut. Weekly coaching sessions, no lasting progress. He changed the format: half the time he coaches her, the other half she coaches him. The reversal gave her purpose and actualization — something the one-directional advice never produced.
